cohort: 124 Women who delivered a live infant at a Southern tertiary medical center between September 1 and November 30, 2018, and requested postpartum sterilization
finding: Women delivering vaginally, those without valid Medicaid consent, and those with BMI > 40 were less likely to receive desired postpartum sterilization.
mod_finding: Women who delivered by cesarean were more likely to receive their postpartum sterilization than those who delivered vaginally.
